name: Fate/Dream Coalescence
source:
As the infamous Fifth Holy Grail War is about to start, one of its main actors is replaced by a mysterious man. How will his arrival change the war? What is his goal? No one knows, though he seems to know more than he should...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221219231833/https://benjilabu.itch.io/fatedream-coalescence]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
臭名昭著的第五次圣杯战争即将开始，其中一位主要演员被一名神秘男子取代。他的到来将如何改变战局？他的目标是什么？没有人知道，尽管他似乎知道的比他应该知道的多……

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221219231833/https://benjilabu.itch.io/fatedream-coalescence]Itch.io[/url]]
